name: Next Billion Children · v3 (Algo Peers family)

tokens.name: ap-blue
tokens.usage: Algo Peers brand blue (Brand Guide p.7). In NBC: machine intelligence. White text 4.54:1; ink text large only.

tokens.name: ap-green
tokens.usage: Algo Peers brand green. In NBC: capability shown again under changed conditions, never a grade. Ink text only (7.98:1).

tokens.name: ap-orange
tokens.usage: Algo Peers primary accent. In NBC: the child's action and the primary button. Ink text (5.64:1); white only at 24px+.

tokens.name: ap-yellow
tokens.usage: Algo Peers brand yellow. In NBC: physical experience and Learning Worlds. Ink text only (10.67:1).

tokens.name: ap-violet
tokens.usage: Algo Peers brand violet. In NBC: evidence and the Human Capability Graph. White text only (6.85:1).

tokens.name: experience
tokens.usage: Thesis formula: physical experience, Learning Worlds, kits. Text on it: `on-bright`.

tokens.name: intelligence
tokens.usage: Thesis formula: machine intelligence (creation, translation, preparation, bounded feedback with human review). Text on it: `on-deep`.

tokens.name: evidence
tokens.usage: Thesis formula: evidence from action, observations, the HCG. Text on it: `on-deep`.

tokens.name: capability
tokens.usage: Thesis formula: capability that holds when the task changes. Never a score. Text on it: `on-bright`.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view (pill button) and the child's move. Text on it: `on-bright`.

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text and icons on experience, capability and action.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on intelligence, evidence and ink blocks.

tokens.name: block-ink
tokens.usage: Ink colour block (master line, 'later' items). Lifts to #2A2A2E in the ink theme so it stays visible. Text: `on-deep`.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: white by default (as Algo Peers); ink for evening and deck-dark use. Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels (flat, no shadow, no border). Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `ground` and `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers; no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control edges (inputs, outlined pills); ≥3:1 on ground and surface.

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text or icon on the ground (Algo Peers link colour made accessible).

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text or icon on the ground.

tokens.name: yellow-ink
tokens.usage: Yellow as text or icon on the ground.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue as text or icon on the ground (#0060DE, the Algo Peers blue hover, so it clears 4.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: violet-ink
tokens.usage: Violet as text or icon on the ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info icon and text; always with a word.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icon and text (interface states only, never about a child).

families.title: Unbounded, "Akira Expanded", "Cera Round Pro", system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: "Cera Round Pro", "Noto Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Website hero and deck cover; uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Algo Peers Title (3em); section openers; uppercase.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Algo Peers Body small (0.875em); the adult minimum.

styles.name: child-label
styles.usage: Child choices and buttons; the child minimum.

tokens.name: r-piece
tokens.usage: The piece: bottom-right corner only, half the side.
